name: CONNECTED Youth Leadership Program (CYLP)
org: Fulton County Government, Community Development (with 21st Century Leaders)
what_you_do: Do a year of online and live leadership training. You explore careers, plan your education path and meet other teens and professionals. Juniors and seniors can get paid summer internships.
who_can_apply: Any high school student who lives in Fulton County, GA. You need a computer, phone or tablet and Wi-Fi.
pay_detail: Free to join. Members can win gift cards from $25 to $100 and other prizes. The page lists paid summer internships for juniors and seniors but gives no pay rate.
deadline_text: 2026-27 enrollment ran Sept 14 to 28, 2026. Next enrollment dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online enrollment form. Do it during the time when sign-up is open.
notes: Enrollment for 2026-27 closed Sept 28, 2026, per the enrollment page. Call the county at 404-612-4000 to ask about late spots. The enrollment page does not mention internships. Only the county page does. Contact: customerservice@fultoncountyga.gov.
